mismatch.message: simple monster action requires uhitm.c mhitm_ad_ssex()

summary: The current step-65 refusal is uhitm.c mhitm_ad_ssex() on the succubus’s zero-damage AD_SSEX bite after the wizard’s second silver-saber swing misses. The recorded setup is female succubus versus female wizard with SYSOPT_SEDUCE enabled: C’s could_seduce() result is 0, so mhitm_ad_ssex() returns without calling doseduce(), leaves damage at 0, and hitmu() continues to the two AD_PHYS claw attacks. The silver-on-hit helper path was not reached by either player swing. The actionable owner is the whole uhitm.c mhitm_ad_ssex() function; its doseduce() return dependency must also be resolved for the other valid branch.

source.branch: For the current refusal, magr != &gy.youmonst and mdef == &gy.youmonst, so mhitm_ad_ssex() takes its mhitu arm. SYSOPT_SEDUCE defaults on and this recipe does not override it. The amorous demon attack table begins with AT_BITE/AD_SSEX/0d0; with a female succubus and female human defender, could_seduce() returns 0. The branch therefore skips doseduce() and returns with mhm.damage still 0 and mhm.done false. hitmu() then continues to the two AT_CLAW/AD_PHYS attacks. Port the entire wrapper, including its uhitm and mhitm arms.
callers: uhitm.c mhitm_adtyping() case AD_SSEX (line 4797) directly calls mhitm_ad_ssex().
mhitu.c hitmu() calls mhitm_adtyping() at line 1191; this is the reached monster-to-hero production route and is wired by js/mhitu.js hitmu() to js/uhitm.js mhitm_adtyping().
mhitm.c mdamagem() calls mhitm_adtyping() at line 1059; the existing JavaScript route is js/mhitm.js mdamagem().
uhitm.c damageum() calls mhitm_adtyping() at line 4854; the existing JavaScript route is js/uhitm.js damageum().

If mhitu.c doseduce() is ported to satisfy the consumed return, also wire its existing sounds.c dosound() caller at line 1112, which discards the return; js/sounds.js currently refuses the non-nymph MS_SEDUCE path.
dependencies: mhitu.c could_seduce() returns an integer consumed by mhitm_ad_ssex() as == 1. Its C body (1934-1981) is pure; js/mhitu.js has a source-referenced implementation, whose source completion and result tests remain separate evidence from the wrapper.

mhitu.c doseduce() returns an integer consumed as a boolean by mhitm_ad_ssex() to set M_ATTK_AGR_DONE and mhm.done. No JavaScript doseduce() implementation exists; js/sounds.js:1308-1310 still refuses its non-nymph seduction path. Because this return is consumed in a valid mhitm_ad_ssex() branch, include the whole mhitu.c doseduce() function (1985-2305) in the same implementation task and wire its production callers.

Within doseduce(), return values used in control flow or state include unresponsive(), canseemon(), welded(), y_n(), m_next2u(), tele_restrict(), u_carried_gloves(), resists_drli(), money_cnt(), and Maybe_Half_Phys(); its rn2/rnd/rn1 calls also affect the recorded sequence. stop_donning() and mayberem() return values are discarded; if those callee paths are unported, record note_unported() and skip them.

uhitm.c mhitm_ad_sedu() is the void helper called by the other mhitm_ad_ssex() arms; the wrapper checks its mhm.done mutation, not its return. js/uhitm.js has a partial body with explicit gaps, so its helper evidence does not complete the mhitm_ad_ssex() wrapper or its other arms.

evidence: The current assignment queue entry reports one remaining screen out of 66, with 65/66 screens and cursors and 2364/2384 RNG calls matched. Its first mismatch is a stop at zero-based step 65: “simple monster action requires uhitm.c mhitm_ad_ssex()”. This is the current explicit JavaScript refusal, not the RNG call-site that appeared in the older comparison.

The immutable case in challenges/manifests/v18.json retains the C-selected two-y continuation. The recording challenges/cases/v18/wizard-wields-silver-saber-retries-succubus-strike-c59.session.json shows step 64 and step 65 each print “You miss the succubus.”; step 65 starts with rnd(20)=14 at hitum(uhitm.c:780). Both C hit checks miss, so the successful-hit path to hmon_hitmon_do_hit()/hmon_hitmon_msg_silver() is not reached. The silver-saber recipe comment documents the same route; silver-on-hit is not the cause of this mismatch.

The same step-65 recording then logs rnd(20)=12 at mattacku(mhitu.c:806), d(0,0)=0 at hitmu(mhitu.c:1187), and two later d(1,3)=3 claw damages. C displays “The succubus hits! The succubus hits again!” and ends at HP 6(12). monsters.h:2922-2934 defines this sequence as AT_BITE/AD_SSEX/0d0 followed by two AT_CLAW/AD_PHYS/1d3 attacks.

nethack-c/upstream/src/sys.c:100 sets sysopt.seduce to 1 by default. In mhitu.c:1934-1981, could_seduce() requires opposite genders for the amorous demon and returns 0 for this female succubus versus female human; in uhitm.c:4759-4779, the SYSOPT_SEDUCE branch then skips doseduce() and returns without changing mhm.damage or mhm.done. hitmu() proceeds with knockback and the two claw attacks at mhitu.c:1191-1219.

The missing behavior is the whole uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_ssex() function at 4751-4779, dispatched from uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping() case AD_SSEX at 4797. The current JavaScript switch at js/uhitm.js:4810 calls the explicit unsupported boundary. Existing production dispatcher callers are mhitu.c:hitmu(), mhitm.c:mdamagem(), and uhitm.c:damageum(), mapped to js/mhitu.js:hitmu(), js/mhitm.js:mdamagem(), and js/uhitm.js:damageum().

The whole wrapper has a valid branch that consumes mhitu.c:doseduce() at uhitm.c:4762-4767. That callee is unported and its integer return sets M_ATTK_AGR_DONE and mhm.done, so project dependency rules require porting it in the same task. Its other direct C caller is sounds.c:dosound() at line 1112; JavaScript currently refuses that non-nymph MS_SEDUCE branch at sounds.js:1308.

Historical counter-evidence: the immutable manifest classifies the older B82 first observed difference at step 65 as rn2(5)=2 from distfleeck(monmove.c:538), with no causal owner. The current saved queue instead reports the AD_SSEX refusal. The earlier RNG tag marks where that older comparison first differed; it does not supersede the current source-traced stop or make the missed silver swings causal.
